agreement: Each standalone verdict equals the reference verdict and the candidate's in-prover verdict for the same input, on every corpus item and every supported host row.
corpus: the golden certificate and its V-00 to V-11 variants
the run's fresh certificate and its V-00 to V-11 variants
distribution: The checker runs with no prover, IDE, registry, network, tactic, plugin or solver at check time.
A dynamically linked checker lists every shared object it loads; its closure is part of the bootstrap manifest.
The source-to-binary mapping records the extraction or compilation command, its inputs and the output digest.

negatives.name: missing runtime
negatives.rule: The checker's declared runtime closure is withheld.

negatives.name: altered checker byte
negatives.rule: One byte of the checker changes; the bootstrap manifest digest check refuses to run it.

negatives.name: incompatible format
negatives.rule: A DS-03 input with version byte 2 (fixture R-F22).

negatives.name: malformed proof
negatives.rule: The V-02 variant of each certificate.

negatives.name: absent dependency
negatives.rule: The build runs with one declared dependency removed.

negatives.name: bootstrap mismatch
negatives.rule: The toolchain archive digest differs from the manifest.
